item.title: Sun AM · Wildcard · Cocaine & Rhinestones: The History of Country Music: CR001 - Ernest Tubb: The Texas Defense
item.itunes:title: Sun AM · Wildcard · Cocaine & Rhinestones: The History of Country Music: CR001 - Ernest Tubb: The Texas Defense
item.description:
Everyone loves Ernest Tubb. So when he straps on a gun belt one night to head across town and snuff out a character named Jim Denny, well, you might guess that ol' Jim had it coming. Maybe he didn't, maybe he did. For you to make up your own mind, we'll need to go behind-the-scenes of 650 AM WSM in Nashville, The Grand Ole Opry and the world of country music publishing companies. This episode is highly recommended for fans of Jimmie Rodgers, Johnny Paycheck, Justin Tubb, George Jones, Johnny Cash, Elvis Presley, Hank Williams, Roy Acuff and Matlock. Yes, Matlock.

Relevant Pictures, Music, Books/Articles, Video Clips and a Text-Version of this story can be found directly at: http://cocaineandrhinestones.com/ernest-tubb-texas-defense

Visit cocaineandrhinestones.com to search for episodes with your favorite characters from country music.

If you enjoy the episode, I would love it if you gave me a good review in your podcast app and told one friend that there's a new country music podcast. Just one friend. Thank you.

-TMC

From Cocaine & Rhinestones: The History of Country Music, first released October 24, 2017.

Decades of silence later, a song written by her son brought the case back to life. item.title: Sat PM · Scamtown: The Book Thief | 9
item.itunes:title: Sat PM · Scamtown: The Book Thief | 9
item.description:
In the late 1980s, university libraries start to notice items missing from their rare book collections and suspect they’ve been robbed. That's when a lone university police officer takes the case, helping to lead the FBI to a mansion in Ottumwa, Iowa, where they make a shocking discovery of more than 23,000 stolen rare books and manuscripts. In a heist spanning 20 years, hundreds of libraries across the United States and Canada had been hit by the most prolific book thief in world history.

Scamtown is an Apple Original podcast, produced by FunMeter. Follow and listen on Apple Podcasts. http://apple.co/Scamtown

From Scamtown, first released September 30, 2024.

item.title: Sat AM · PsycHacks: Episode 676: Why men want young women (build-a-girl)
item.itunes:title: Sat AM · PsycHacks: Episode 676: Why men want young women (build-a-girl)
item.description:
Over and above the obvious reproductive benefits, men of all ages tend to prefer young women for another reason: the malleability that they still exhibit. From a psychological standpoint, this is why men want young women. At the heart of this desire is the Pygmalion Gambit: the strategy of seeking out a younger partner that can be molded into an ideal companion. However, this build-a-girl approach to relationships carries significant risks: from differences in maturity to unrealistic expectations for the future.

item.title: Sat AM · The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett: Most Replayed Moment: Why 3 Meals A Day Could Be Aging You! Harvard Longevity Scientist
item.itunes:title: Sat AM · The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett: Most Replayed Moment: Why 3 Meals A Day Could Be Aging You! Harvard Longevity Scientist
item.description:
What if the way you eat is quietly deciding how fast you age? David Sinclair is a Professor of Genetics at Harvard Medical School, one of the world's leading researchers on ageing and longevity, and the author of the New York Times bestseller Lifespan: Why We Age and Why We Don't Have To. In this moment, David gives Steven a first-hand taste of what old age really feels like, and challenges what most of us assume about how long we'd actually want to live. He reveals the tiny "bodyguards" inside your cells that decide how quickly you age, the fasting window he aims for, the popular diet he's sceptical of, and the simple morning swap he made for his longevity. Listen to the full episode here! Spotify: https://g2ul0.app.link/Rti2UtFW26b Apple: https://g2ul0.app.link/Xpy2vxLW26b Watch the Episodes On YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/%20TheDiaryOfACEO/videos David Sinclair: https://sinclair.hms.harvard.edu/people/david-sinclair

From The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett, first released November 20, 2026.

item.description:

And in Jessica Treadway’s “First Day,” a woman views getting sacked as a new beginning. It’s read by Carrie Coon.

item.title: Thu PM · The Book Club | PragerU: Mike Benz: Moby-Dick by Herman Melville | The Book Club | PragerU
item.itunes:title: Thu PM · The Book Club | PragerU: Mike Benz: Moby-Dick by Herman Melville | The Book Club | PragerU
item.description:
This episode of The Book Club features Michael Knowles joined by Mike Benz, executive director of the Foundation for Freedom Online, to discuss Herman Melville’s Moby-Dick. Together, they explore Ishmael’s restless voyage to sea, the novel’s many biblical allusions, and the question at its center. Is Captain Ahab a madman consumed by revenge or a great man of history with an indomitable will? Knowles sees in Ahab the dark side of individualism. Benz makes a contrarian case for the captain who would risk everything to face the whale.

Moby-Dick offers a timeless challenge for young men who may feel adrift in today’s culture: Find a mission bigger than yourself, and choose carefully what kind of man you become along the way.

item.description:
Note: This episode originally ran in 2015 .

German families in the 60s loved tasty, cheap American-raised chicken that was suddenly coming in after the war. And Americans were loving fun, cheap Volkswagen Beetles. This arrangement was too good to last.

Today on the show, how a trade dispute over frozen chicken parts changed the American auto industry as we know it.
